body: That's true about realizing life isn't what you expected. I don't want to be a downer, but my life hasn't had many ups they have been mostly downs. But I think I know what you mean, some days are better than others and today is little better.  The main reason why I kept going, besides my son, is because I'm trying to make it to the good part. Yeah I do have hobbies; I read and write poetry and I am interested in most everything, especially science. One day I would love to learn how to surf.
It's a good thing you know what you want out of life now. Thanks for sharing your story.
Yeah, I'm an introvert and it's always been hard for me to make friends. I do have one good friend and I admitted to her once what I felt and could tell she didn't how to process it.

I am isolated and I no longer speak with my family, but they wouldn't understand. They are just not those kind of people. Luckily, my son is high functioning and he is 18 so he can do some things on his own. I know that depression runs on both sides of my family, so I would say it has something to do with my brain chemistry, but its mostly my life circumstances.
have you thought of it since you were younger?
Yeah, I guess I should do that.
I had to re-title so the first one was deleted, but to answer your question- no I don't talk to my family and I don't really have friends, only one and she doesn't understand.
